text: The SIPROTEC 7SK82 is a motor protection device specifically designed for small to medium-sized motors. Its powerful protection functions ensure motor safety by preventing damage from thermal overload, short circuits, and ground faults. The device delivers this comprehensive protection in a compact and cost-optimized solution.
